# INSTALLTEC

> > Kansas City's premier specialty contractor for spray foam insulation, fireproofing, EIFS systems, and acoustic treatments in commercial construction.

INSTALLTEC is a Midwest-based subcontractor specializing in spray-applied building envelope solutions, fireproofing systems, and acoustic treatments for commercial and institutional projects. The company serves the Kansas City region and beyond with expertise in spray foam insulation, intumescent coatings, EIFS cladding, K-13 acoustic spray, and specialty roof coatings.

## Key Topics

- Spray Foam Insulation
- EIFS Systems
- Fireproofing Services
- Intumescent Paint
- K-13 Acoustic Treatment
- Building Envelope
- Commercial Construction
- Specialty Contractor
- Kansas City
- Midwest Construction
- CelluShield
- Isolatek
- Dryvit
- Roof Coatings
- Fire Protection
